subject: CS477
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos covering all 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The English selections are dominated by highly-viewed, high-quality content from channels like Gate Smashers, Education 4u, and Jenny's Lectures. The Arabic selections are also strong, with channels like Student Guide, مبادرة زاد, and Ahmed Abdelghany providing solid educational content, though with generally lower view counts than their English counterparts. All chosen videos are highly relevant and meet all quality criteria.

videos.title: Lec-3: Lexical Analysis in Compiler Design with Examples
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video provides a concise and clear explanation of lexical analysis and tokenization with examples, making it an ideal starting point.

videos.title: Lec-7: What is Parsing & Types of Parsers | Syntax Analysis
videos.filter_reason: With over 1.6 million views, this video serves as an excellent introduction to parsing, clearly explaining the role of the syntax analyzer and the different types of parsers (Top-Down, Bottom-Up).

videos.title: Type checking | CD | Compiler Design | Lec-39 | Bhanu Priya
videos.filter_reason: A focused and very popular video that directly explains the concept of type checking, covering static vs. dynamic checks, which is central to semantic analysis.

videos.title: Lec-23: What is 3-Address Code in Compiler
videos.filter_reason: This is the most popular video on the topic, offering a very direct and concise explanation of Three-Address Code, the most common form of intermediate code.

videos.title: C_06 Execution Process of a C Program | C Programming Tutorials
videos.filter_reason: This video clearly explains the entire execution process of a C program, covering the roles of the pre-processor, compiler, assembler, linker, and loader, which perfectly matches the topic.

videos.title: شرح عربى Lexical Analysis Tokens and Lexemes Compiler Design
videos.filter_reason: This is the most viewed and most relevant Arabic video, providing a clear explanation of lexical analysis, tokens, and lexemes.

videos.title: Compiler Design (المترجمات) | LL(1) Parsing Table
videos.filter_reason: The highest-viewed Arabic video on this topic, it provides a clear, practical explanation of constructing an LL(1) parsing table, a core parsing algorithm.

videos.title: Semantic Analysis intro (Attribute Grammar) ISSR CS510 (Arabic)
videos.filter_reason: This is the most popular and in-depth eligible video, explaining semantic analysis through the core concept of Attribute Grammars.

videos.title: Three-Address code & Quadrable|Trible (Code Generation) "شـرح" - Compiler
videos.filter_reason: This is the best available option, clearly explaining Three-Address Code and its representations (Quadruples, Triples), with the highest view count among eligible candidates.

videos.title: 26 - Compilation process and Linker script File
videos.filter_reason: An excellent and directly relevant video that explains the compilation process and the role of the linker script file, making it the best choice for this topic in Arabic.
